howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.section1.title: Smart Matching
howItWorks.section1.body: We aggregate job listings from Seek, LinkedIn, and APSJobs into one searchable database. When you upload your resume, our AI scores each job against your skills, experience, and qualifications — giving you a transparent breakdown of why each score was assigned.
howItWorks.section2.title: Tailored Drafts
howItWorks.section2.body: Generate customised cover letters and APS selection criteria responses in seconds. These are starting points — editable drafts that save you time, not finished products. Always review and personalise before submitting.
howItWorks.section3.title: Your Privacy
howItWorks.section3.body: Your data stays on this platform. We don't create public profiles, share your information with employers, or sell your data. You can delete your account and all associated data at any time. We comply with the Australian Privacy Act 1988.
